name: Chrome DevTools MCP
description: Connect Claude Code to Chrome DevTools Protocol for DOM inspection, console logs, network monitoring, and screenshots.
longDescription:
Chrome DevTools MCP bridges Claude Code with the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), giving your AI assistant direct access to a running browser. Inspect DOM elements, read console logs, monitor network requests, evaluate JavaScript expressions, capture screenshots, and navigate pages — all through natural language commands.

## Requirements

Start Chrome with remote debugging enabled:
```bash
google-chrome --remote-debugging-port=9222
# or on macOS:
open -a 'Google Chrome' --args --remote-debugging-port=9222
```

## Tools

- **devtools_get_console_logs** — Retrieve browser console output (errors, warnings, logs)
- **devtools_evaluate** — Execute arbitrary JavaScript in the page context
- **devtools_query_selector** — Find DOM elements and extract their properties
- **devtools_get_network_requests** — List XHR/fetch requests with status codes and timing
- **devtools_take_screenshot** — Capture full-page or viewport screenshots
- **devtools_get_page_info** — Get current URL, page title, and cookie count
- **devtools_navigate** — Navigate the browser to any URL
- **devtools_click** — Click DOM elements by CSS selector

name: GitHub MCP
description: Full GitHub integration — manage issues, PRs, repos, and code search directly from Claude Code.
longDescription:
GitHub MCP gives Claude Code comprehensive access to the GitHub API. Create and review pull requests, manage issues, search code across repositories, fetch file contents, and automate your GitHub workflow without leaving your editor.

## Setup

You'll need a GitHub Personal Access Token with the appropriate scopes.

## Tools

- **github_search_code** — Full-text search across GitHub repositories
- **github_get_file** — Fetch any file from any repository
- **github_create_issue** — Open issues with labels and assignees
- **github_create_pr** — Submit pull requests from a branch
- **github_list_prs** — List open/closed PRs with filters
- **github_merge_pr** — Merge pull requests
- **github_get_commit** — Inspect commit details and diffs
- **github_list_repos** — List repositories for a user or organization

name: Filesystem MCP
description: Enhanced filesystem access with glob patterns, file watching, batch operations, and archive support.
longDescription:
Filesystem MCP extends Claude Code's built-in file access with power-user features: recursive glob search, real-time file watching, batch rename/copy/move operations, ZIP and tar archive extraction, and smart file diffing.

## Tools

- **fs_glob** — Find files using glob patterns with exclusion support
- **fs_watch** — Watch directories for changes (returns events)
- **fs_batch_rename** — Rename multiple files with regex or templates
- **fs_archive_extract** — Extract ZIP, tar.gz, tar.bz2 archives
- **fs_diff** — Generate unified diffs between files or directories
- **fs_disk_usage** — Analyze disk usage by directory
- **fs_find_duplicates** — Locate duplicate files by content hash

name: PostgreSQL MCP
description: Query, inspect, and manage PostgreSQL databases — schema exploration, query execution, and migrations.
longDescription:
PostgreSQL MCP lets Claude Code talk directly to your Postgres database. Explore schemas, run queries, generate migrations, analyze slow queries, and get intelligent schema documentation — all through natural language.

## Tools

- **pg_query** — Execute SELECT queries (read-only by default)
- **pg_execute** — Run INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE with transaction support
- **pg_list_tables** — Enumerate tables with row counts
- **pg_describe_table** — Get column types, constraints, and indexes
- **pg_explain** — Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a query
- **pg_list_functions** — List stored procedures and functions
- **pg_migrations** — List applied and pending migrations

name: Playwright MCP
description: Browser automation and end-to-end testing with Playwright — navigate, click, fill forms, and assert UI state.
longDescription:
Playwright MCP integrates the Playwright browser automation library with Claude Code. Write and run E2E tests, automate repetitive browser tasks, take screenshots for visual regression, and debug flaky tests — using natural language instructions.

## Tools

- **pw_navigate** — Open a URL in Chromium, Firefox, or WebKit
- **pw_click** — Click elements by selector, text, or role
- **pw_fill** — Fill input fields and text areas
- **pw_screenshot** — Capture screenshots (full page or element)
- **pw_assert_text** — Assert that text appears on the page
- **pw_wait_for** — Wait for selectors, navigation, or network idle
- **pw_get_html** — Extract inner HTML of an element
- **pw_run_test** — Execute a Playwright test file

name: OpenAI MCP
description: Access OpenAI APIs — GPT-4, embeddings, DALL-E image generation, Whisper transcription from Claude Code.
longDescription:
OpenAI MCP wraps the OpenAI API suite, letting Claude Code call GPT-4 for second opinions, generate embeddings for semantic search, create images with DALL-E 3, and transcribe audio with Whisper.

## Tools

- **openai_chat** — Call GPT-4o/GPT-4/GPT-3.5 with a prompt
- **openai_embed** — Generate text embeddings (text-embedding-3-small)
- **openai_image_generate** — Create images with DALL-E 3
- **openai_transcribe** — Transcribe audio files with Whisper
- **openai_moderate** — Check content against OpenAI moderation policy

name: Datadog MCP
description: Query Datadog metrics, logs, and monitors — triage incidents and investigate performance issues with AI assistance.
longDescription:
Datadog MCP connects Claude Code to Datadog's observability platform. Pull metrics, search logs, check monitor status, inspect APM traces, and get dashboards — making incident response and performance investigation conversational.

## Tools

- **dd_query_metrics** — Query time-series metrics with Datadog query syntax
- **dd_search_logs** — Full-text log search with facet filtering
- **dd_list_monitors** — List monitors with alert status
- **dd_get_apm_traces** — Retrieve distributed traces by service or operation
- **dd_list_dashboards** — List dashboards with links
- **dd_get_incidents** — List open and recent incidents

name: Linear MCP
description: Manage Linear issues and projects — create tasks, update statuses, query the backlog, and track cycles.
longDescription:
Linear MCP integrates Claude Code with the Linear project management API. Query issues, create tasks from your conversations, update statuses, assign team members, and track sprint progress — all without leaving your coding environment.

## Tools

- **linear_list_issues** — List issues with filters (status, assignee, label, priority)
- **linear_create_issue** — Create new issues with full metadata
- **linear_update_issue** — Update status, priority, assignee, or labels
- **linear_get_cycles** — List sprints and their completion rates
- **linear_search** — Full-text search across issues and comments
- **linear_get_teams** — List teams and their workflows

name: Redis MCP
description: Interact with Redis — get/set keys, inspect data structures, monitor pub/sub, and analyze memory usage.
longDescription:
Redis MCP provides Claude Code with direct access to your Redis instance. Read and write all Redis data types (strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets), subscribe to channels, inspect TTLs, analyze memory consumption, and run Lua scripts.

## Tools

- **redis_get** / **redis_set** — Read and write string keys
- **redis_hgetall** / **redis_hset** — Hash map operations
- **redis_lpush** / **redis_lrange** — List operations
- **redis_sadd** / **redis_smembers** — Set operations
- **redis_zadd** / **redis_zrange** — Sorted set operations
- **redis_scan** — Cursor-based key iteration
- **redis_info** — Server statistics and memory usage
- **redis_publish** — Publish messages to channels
